testcase.name: restored code is reserved before a fresh process creates a retry ticket
pending redacted export cannot be replaced or upgraded to full and consumes once
concurrent duplicate callbacks receive exactly one frozen payload
wrong identity cannot consume or cancel a pending snapshot
sixteen bit request code exhaustion refuses reuse rather than wrap
export serializes immediately so mutable report members and later report changes cannot alter payload
fresh process controller has no old payload and old UUID cannot consume its new payload
restoration only advances valid request codes and never wraps or lowers high water mark
cancel discards snapshot and retry gets new identity and nonreused code immune to stale ticket
